♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: With the Moon in Leo in Magha nakshatra moving through your 5th house, your natural fire is amplified for expression, risk-taking and visibility. Jupiter, also in early Leo, adds a regal, confident undertone, while the Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in Libra activate your 7th house of partners and key allies. Mars still in late Cancer stirs your 4th house, agitating the emotional base. It’s a day when your desire to shine and create is strong, but the feedback from close others keeps you honest.

💼 Career: This is a good day for presentations, pitching ideas, or taking the lead on something that needs personality as well as competence. 5th-house Leo Moon with Jupiter favors creative risks and visible contributions. At the same time, the Libra cluster in your 7th puts negotiation and collaboration at the center of career moves: you can’t just charge ahead; you need to co-design the path with clients, partners or stakeholders. Use the retrograde energy to revisit how your agreements are structured—are you getting enough credit for your creative input? Mars in your 4th can make work issues feel personal; step back before reacting to perceived slights.

❤️ Love: Relationships today mirror back your need to be seen. The 7th-house Libra emphasis makes you more aware of how fairly attention, affection and decision-making are shared. With the Moon and Jupiter lighting your 5th, you’re more playful and flirtatious, but someone close may ask for consistency, not just enthusiasm. If partnered, it’s a good day for planning something fun together that still respects both of your schedules and needs. If single, romantic openings come through social spaces where you’re able to showcase your talents—creative events, performances, or group activities.

💰 Money: The Leo 5th activation can incline you toward generous and speculative spending—on hobbies, outings, entertainment, or children. Some of this can be healthy if it supports real joy, but keep an eye on overestimating returns, whether in actual investments or in betting on a pet project. The Libra 7th emphasis highlights shared arrangements: fee splits, commissions, or informal deals with others. Retrograde Venus and Mercury favor adjusting terms to reflect current reality rather than vague past promises. Clarify who is responsible for which costs before you commit to a joint plan.

🧘 Advice: Let yourself reach for the spotlight where it matters most, but ask one trusted person to reality-check your bolder impulses before you lock them in.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your brilliance lands best today when you treat collaboration as a stage, not a cage.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Moon’s passage through Leo in Magha lights up your 4th house of home, inner safety and emotional roots, conjoining expansive Jupiter there. The Libra trio—Sun, retrograde Mercury, retrograde Venus—activates your 6th house of routines, obligations and health. Mars in late Cancer fires your 3rd house, sharpening thoughts and speech. You’re pulled toward tending your private world while also being pushed to refine daily systems.

💼 Career: Work today benefits from organizing your base of operations. With the Moon and Jupiter in your 4th, a more stable, inspiring workspace—whether at home or office—directly supports productivity. You may feel the urge to rearrange, redecorate or reset boundaries with housemates or family around work time. The Libra 6th-house focus urges you to rebalance your task list and renegotiate duties where things have become lopsided. Retrograde Venus and Mercury favor correcting old workflow issues, revising schedules, or reworking how you collaborate with colleagues. Mars in your 3rd gives you courage to address misunderstandings, but guard against curt emails or sarcastic comments.

❤️ Love: Emotional security becomes a central theme. The Leo 4th-house Moon can make you crave warmth and admiration from those closest to you, but it may also spotlight where you’ve been hiding hurt pride. The Libra 6th influence reminds you that love is woven into everyday actions—how chores are shared, how you show up when the other person is tired. If partnered, small gestures of reliability count more today than dramatic promises. If single, you may notice attraction to someone whose consistent kindness feels like a safe place to land, possibly through work or everyday environments.

💰 Money: Jupiter transiting your 4th often corresponds with spending or opportunity tied to home, family or property over the longer term. Today’s Leo Moon might tempt you toward upgrades or comforts. Choose one or two improvements that genuinely enhance your sense of stability rather than a flurry of decorative purchases. The Libra 6th-house stellium supports reviewing subscriptions, service costs and work-related expenses for balance and fairness. It’s a practical time to adjust payment plans, renegotiate hours-for-pay agreements, or drop minor financial leaks you’ve been tolerating.

🧘 Advice: Before taking on one more responsibility, ask whether it nourishes your inner life or slowly erodes it—and let that answer guide your choice.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Protecting your peace isn’t laziness today; it’s the foundation that lets your steady effort actually bloom.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: With the Moon in Leo in Magha igniting your 3rd house of communication, learning and local movement—and Jupiter amplifying that same zone—your mind is bright, expressive and outward-facing. The Sun, retrograde Mercury (your ruler) and retrograde Venus in Libra enliven your 5th house of creativity, romance and self-expression. Mars in late Cancer activates your 2nd house of speech and resources, adding intensity to what you say and how you value yourself. It’s a highly mental, expressive day with real potential to reshape your narrative.

💼 Career: This is excellent energy for writing, speaking, presenting, or brainstorming. Ideas can come quickly and dramatically under the Leo 3rd-house Moon with Jupiter; some may be larger than you can execute immediately, so capture them and then sort. The Libra 5th-house stellium asks you to refine the creative face of your work—branding, design, tone of communications, or how you pitch projects. Because Mercury and Venus are retrograde, it’s ideal for revising existing material, reviving a shelved idea, or reworking your portfolio, rather than launching something entirely new. Mars in your 2nd can push you to assert your worth more strongly; prepare facts and examples before you ask for recognition or better pay.

❤️ Love: Flirtatious, playful energy is high. The Libra 5th focus naturally pulls you toward pleasure, romance and spontaneous connection. Old romantic themes may resurface—an earlier crush, a past version of your relationship, or an artistic passion you once shared with someone. The Leo Moon in your 3rd favors heartfelt conversations, expressive messages and perhaps a short trip or outing together. If partnered, plan something that stimulates both mind and heart—an engaging discussion, shared creative endeavor, or a playful date. If single, connections may arise through social media, classes, or local events where you can freely show your wit and charm.

💰 Money: Mars in your 2nd house can bring both determination and impatience around finances. You’re more inclined to take quick action—asking for fair compensation, launching a small side effort, or cutting off an arrangement that feels undervalued. The Leo 3rd and Libra 5th activation may also tempt impulse purchases on gadgets, courses, entertainment or creative tools. Invest where there is a clear path to either skill-building or genuine joy; pause before spending purely to impress. Retrograde Venus encourages you to review how much money goes toward “looking creative” versus genuinely supporting your talents.

🧘 Advice: Before you hit send or speak off the cuff, ask whether your words build the story you actually want to live in six months from now.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your voice is strongest today when it shines, not to prove you’re clever, but to reveal what you truly care about.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

The Libra trio—Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus—activates your 4th house of home and emotional foundations. Mars still in late Cancer in your 1st house keeps your personal drive—and at times irritability—high. The focus shifts from raw emotion to clarifying what and who you truly value.

💼 Career: Today is well-suited to practical evaluation of your resources. The Leo 2nd-house Moon with Jupiter encourages you to think bigger about what your skills are worth, but also to recognize where generosity has outpaced realism. You may feel more confident discussing pay, fees or budgets. The Libra 4th-house emphasis links professional decisions with home and family considerations—perhaps revisiting whether your current work setup supports the private life you need. Retrograde Mercury and Venus favor reviewing old agreements about working hours, remote arrangements, or family involvement in your work path. Mars in your 1st can lend courage to advocate for yourself, as long as you temper reactivity.

❤️ Love: Emotional themes continue, but with a different flavor. The 4th-house Libra cluster asks you to look at the atmosphere of your home life: is it balanced, aesthetically pleasing, and fair in how responsibilities and emotional labor are shared? Meanwhile, Moon and Jupiter in your 2nd highlight the importance of feeling valued—not just in words, but in how your time and needs are treated. If partnered, conversations about living arrangements, family boundaries or domestic roles can move forward if framed as creating beauty and balance for both of you. If single, you may feel drawn to someone who appreciates your loyalty and caretaking, and who also brings warmth into your physical environment.

💰 Money: This is a day to look closely, yet optimistically, at finances. The Leo 2nd-house influence can bring opportunities to increase income or at least see new ways to use your talents. Jupiter’s presence, however, also expands spending desires; luxurious items, gifts for loved ones, or home improvements may beckon. The Libra 4th-house stellium suggests that money may be directed toward housing, decor, or family obligations. Retrogrades support refinancing, renegotiating rent or mortgage terms, or revisiting past financial arrangements with relatives to make them fairer.

🧘 Advice: When you feel the urge to protect or provide for everyone, pause and ask what concrete act of care you’re willing to extend to yourself first.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The security you’re building today begins where your sense of worth stops depending on who you shelter and starts including how you shelter yourself.
leo:
♌ Leo

The Libra 3rd-house focus underscores the importance of how you communicate that leadership: through diplomacy, clear language and thoughtful listening. Retrograde Mercury and Venus support revising pitches, editing documents, and correcting misunderstandings. Mars in your 12th warns against sabotaging yourself through rushed decisions made from unprocessed anxieties; give big choices a night’s rest when possible.

❤️ Love: The Moon in your sign accentuates your emotional needs and makes you more expressive, perhaps more dramatic, in love. You’re likely to crave recognition and heart-centered connection. Jupiter’s presence blesses you with warmth and generosity, but might also tempt you to overlook red flags. The Libra 3rd-house activation favors heartfelt conversations, texts, and exchanges that clarify where you and another actually stand. If partnered, share not just what you want, but also how you’re working on yourself; your willingness to own your own patterns strengthens trust. If single, you may attract attention through your voice, writing or social media presence as much as physical magnetism.

💰 Money: While today’s focus is more on you than your accounts, the Leo 1st-house amplification can indirectly affect finances by nudging you to make purchases that match your desired image or comfort. Some investment in appearance or tools that help you communicate better may be worthwhile, but monitor the urge to treat spending as a shortcut to self-esteem. The Libra 3rd-house trio supports revisiting phone, internet, transport, and education-related costs—small recurring expenses that add up over time. A thoughtful tweak here can improve your financial breathing room.

🧘 Advice: When you feel the pull to make a grand move, ask yourself what simple, grounded action would express the same intention without burning reserves you still need.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your real radiance today comes less from being the loudest presence in the room and more from being the clearest about who you choose to be.
virgo:
